scope: Restore the Publish 14.1 fixed 25-second resource-sampling cadence while preserving the existing Quickness-derived Action cost, sampling loop, resource result calculation, effects, and retained content.

findings: The pinned Publish 14.1 implementation schedules each sample task at 25000 milliseconds.
Publish 14.1 uses current Quickness only for the sampling Action cost formula 124 - Quickness / 12.5.
The inherited survey tool retained an NGE expertise_resource_sampling_time_decrease modifier that could reduce the cadence from 25 seconds to a 10-second floor.
The existing getSurveyToolDelay ABI is retained so every current loop and watchdog caller receives the fixed Publish 14.1 cadence.

auditBoundary.closedInThisMilestone: the active NGE expertise-derived resource-sampling cadence and its 10-second floor
auditBoundary.preserved: the 25-second Publish 14.1 sample schedule, Quickness-derived Action cost, sampling admission and cancellation, result quantity and quality, resource containers, effects, radioactive handling, concentrated-resource content, XP chance, and the existing helper ABI
auditBoundary.notClaimedComplete: reverse engineering, retained vendor maintenance, armor, healing, movement, performance, and other content-specific expertise references remain subject to later reachability audits
